pages.title: Dataset v2: live random sample
pages.intro: 24 randomly sampled finished images from output_dataset/v2_3000, with their YOLO boxes, plus live progress of the render. Works while the dataset is still being generated: the info panel refreshes every 10 s, and Resample draws a new random 24 from everything finished so far. Needs the local server: python3 scripts/serve_dataset_view.py, then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/showcase.html#dataset.

glossary.finished image: An image whose label file (labels/<split>/<name>.txt) and sidecar (meta/<name>.json, written last) both exist and are complete.
glossary.box: One YOLO label line (class xc yc w h, normalised to the image size), drawn as a green rectangle.
glossary.seed: base_seed:render_index, i.e. render_scene(seed=2026, index=k); retries use index 100000 + 10 k + attempt.
glossary.sun_el / shadow / overcast: Sun elevation in degrees, direct-sun shadow strength, overcast (soft light) flag.
glossary.scale: Mean mine scale of the image (MINE_SCALE; 0.1-0.4).
glossary.buried / burial_max: Number of buried mines; largest achieved hidden fraction of a mine's top-down area.
glossary.face_down / blades_on_mine: Number of face-down mines; grass blades drawn over mines.
glossary.rate / ETA: Finished images per minute over the last 10 min, and the time left at that rate.
